subject: Justin Tseng Re-Election Campaign Announcement
overview: Councilor Justin Tseng announced his candidacy for re-election to the Medford City Council. He highlighted first-term achievements regarding housing and education while outlining a platform focused on climate action and infrastructure.

items.title: Re-Election Campaign Announcement
items.summary: Councilor Justin Tseng announced his run for re-election, citing legislative progress on affordable housing, school funding, and environmental protection. His platform for the upcoming term includes addressing the housing crisis, implementing a climate agenda, and improving city infrastructure like roads and sidewalks.
